ownership.businessAuthority: Reserved/not-implemented mobile platform-operator runtime. Its former Firestore implementation (seller/user management, commissions, marketing, moderation queues, KYC) was deleted in phase FB-1 under the owner decision of 2026-09-05 to retire Firebase completely; it had never shipped a signed release. This root owns no active operator behavior. apps/admin_web owns the active platform-operator surface and services/api-gateway owns the operator APIs behind it (/operations/marketplace-listings, PHASE-ADM-1).

deploymentAuthority.platform: Reserved only - no deployable mobile runtime artifact

observabilityAuthority.logging: No active mobile operator runtime logging; apps/admin_web and services/api-gateway emit current operator telemetry.
observabilityAuthority.audit: No active audit emission from this reserved mobile root; operator mutations are audited by services/api-gateway (audit_logs).

executionAuthority.executionRole: Reserved/not-implemented mobile root; does not own active routing, rendering, presentation adapters, runtime transport, mobile release artifacts, or runtime bootstrapping. apps/admin_web owns the active platform-operator presentation surface and services/api-gateway owns operator API behavior; no operator mobile app is implemented.
executionAuthority.orchestrationRole: No active service-local event helpers execution; current workflows delegate to implemented web and service runtimes plus package-owned policy.
executionAuthority.infrastructureOwnership: No active runtime infrastructure ownership; future activation requires mobile source, package/deployment config, tests, and governance approval.
executionAuthority.eventOwnership: No active event execution ownership; current event handling delegates to implemented runtimes.
executionAuthority.queryOwnership: No active query execution ownership; current reads delegate to implemented runtimes.
executionAuthority.compositionOwnership: No active mobile runtime composition ownership; current composition delegates to implemented runtimes.

implementationStatus.currentActiveOwner: apps/admin_web owns the active platform-operator presentation surface and services/api-gateway owns operator API behavior; no operator mobile app is implemented.
implementationStatus.activationRequirement: Reserved by phase FB-1 (2026-09-05). Reactivation requires BOTH a named trigger and human approval: the admin_web moderation port (CAP-ADM-2) complete, a measured demand for a mobile operator surface, and gateway-wired source with tests, deployment config and an ARB-approved governance update. The deleted implementation was Firestore-backed and must never be restored; it is readable in git history at the parent of the FB-1 branch as a behavioural reference only.
